summary.headline: Horary Judgment on the Kingdom
summary.text: Horary interrogation describing planetary positions for an ascendant at 9° Sagittarius, followed by interpretation of Jupiter, the Sun, Venus, and the Moon as testimonies of the ruler’s strength, honor, and attainment of his kingdom. The analysis then turns to the rebel governor of Africa, examining Gemini on the Nadir, Mercury retrograde and cadent, and Mercury’s opposition with Saturn.
